Equality-case enumeration of three possible end-block patterns, followed by b_3/a_2 defense contradictions (including n=4 overlap checks), forces this unique optimum. Independently enumerated 4^(2n) labelings for n=2,3,4,5: weights 6,8,8,8; multiplicities 5,9,1,1 and exactly the stated lists for n=2,3. Arbitrary n>=4 follows from the block proof, not the finite enumeration.
